title: Embedded ClickHouse analytics with chDB: typed datasets, a CLI and an API, no server
outcome: Run a ClickHouse semantic layer inside your Python process with chDB: no Docker, no server, then point the same datasets at ClickHouse Cloud.

env.name: ANALYTICS_BACKEND
env.description: chdb (default: embedded, no server) or clickhouse (the same datasets on a server, read from CLICKHOUSE_*)

env.name: CHDB_PATH
env.description: chDB database directory (default ./analytics.chdb, built on first run)

env.name: HYPEQUERY_DEV_TOKEN
env.description: Bearer token the demo API accepts. Defaults to local-dev-token; replace with real auth before deploying.

env.name: CLICKHOUSE_URL
env.description: Only with ANALYTICS_BACKEND=clickhouse: ClickHouse HTTP endpoint (default http://localhost:8123)

env.name: CLICKHOUSE_USERNAME
env.description: Only with ANALYTICS_BACKEND=clickhouse: ClickHouse user (default: default)

env.name: CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD
env.description: Only with ANALYTICS_BACKEND=clickhouse: ClickHouse password (default: hypequery, the seed's password)

env.name: CLICKHOUSE_DATABASE
env.description: Only with ANALYTICS_BACKEND=clickhouse: database holding events and tenants (default hypequery_examples)
